brief:
Israeli state broadcaster reported a significant threat to Yair Netanyahu, son of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, prompting authorities to urgently evacuate him from the United States to Tel Aviv, Shehab Wire reported. The broadcaster did not specify the nature or source of the threat beyond attributing it to Iranian elements.

The evacuation marks a rare public security action involving a family member of the Israeli prime minister. Yair Netanyahu has drawn controversy in recent years for social media posts and public statements, though details about his current location and movements are typically kept confidential. Israeli officials have previously disclosed Iranian plots against senior government figures and military commanders.
